jobs.description:
Want to join an energetic, international team where your hard work pays off big time? Whoop whoop! As a Warehouse Worker at CB (Centraal Boekhuis) in Culemborg, you will be right in the middle of the action, handling millions of books every single day! Besides a great starting salary of € 15.49 per hour, you can earn up to a massive € 28.13 per hour thanks to our awesome evening and weekend allowances! And the best part? You are the boss of your own calendar. Simply choose which days fit your schedule and let’s goooo! Ready to start your new work adventure? Read on and apply today! 👇

What we offer
- Up to € 28.13 per hour including  Sunday bonuses!
- A reliable base salary of € 15.49 per hour!
- Flexibility: you decide which days you work!
- Working in an international and fun team!
- Travel allowance of € 0.19 per km!
- Physically light work: super easy!

Who you are
To keep the CB warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you match the following hard criteria:

- You speak and understand enough English or Dutch to have a conversation.
- You have your own accommodation in the Culemborg area.
- You have your own transport (like a car or bicycle) to easily reach the work location.
- You are available to work every Monday.
- On your chosen workdays, you are available for either the morning shift (07:30 - 16:30) or the afternoon/evening shift (16:00 - 00:30).
- It is very busy at CB in the summer, so it is important that you do not have any vacation plans for August and September.

What will you do
BAM! Say goodbye to boring routines. Your day as a warehouse worker is packed with variety, making time fly by. Together with your friendly colleagues, you will perform these key tasks:

- Collect book orders seamlessly using a smart, digital pick-to-light system 💡
- Restock the warehouse shelves efficiently so your team never runs out of items
- Pack orders neatly into boxes, slap on the shipping labels, and prepare them for transport 📦
- Keep your workspace ti

Working in a book paradise. Yes! Get started as an orderpicker with an EKS truck for which you will be trained. You'll be a pro in no time! 🚀 You get a full-time hours guarantee and earn €15.49 per hour. With allowances, this can go up to €28.13 per hour. Ideal, right?! ✨ CB is rated as a top employer and has an 8+ for job satisfaction #baanrader. Don't wait any longer and read on to discover more about this job! 👇

What we offer
- Earn at least €15,49 per hour!
- On Sundays, you earn an 85% surcharge!
- A full-time job  with part-time options as well!
- Travel allowance of €0.19 per km!
- Learn to drive the EKS truck at CB!
- Nice canteen, staff outings, and more benefits!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running as an order picker, it is important that you meet the following requirements at CB:

- You are willing to work preferably full-time (40 hours) (we can discuss what is possible for part-time)
- You are available to work every Monday;
- You are available for at least 2 shifts (8:30-16:30, 17:00-01:00 or 22:00-06:30);
- You want to learn to drive an EKS truck;
- You can perform lifting tasks up to 10 kilos;
- You speak enough Dutch and/or English to have a conversation;
- It is busy at CB in the summer, so it is important that you are available until October

What will you do
As an order picker at CB, you and your colleagues will gather various orders of books. This way, you complete the order for packing and shipping to the customer. Because you work quickly and accurately, the customer receives their order on time! Great job! 🚀 During order picking, you make extensive use of an EKS truck. This is an electric order picking truck. With it, you will retrieve stacks of books from the correct shelf and then transport them to the other side of the warehouse. You can also use it to pick books from shelves up to 3 meters high. 🤩 No experience with an electric truck yet? You will receive training for this at CB. Ideal, because you learn a new skill right awa

As a production worker, you’ll be part of a lively team of over 30 colleagues in a modern production facility. Working in a 2-shift system, you’ll help oversee the entire production process — from raw materials to finished products. We produce a wide variety of peanut butter for a diverse customer base, so no two days are the same.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Operating and setting up production machines

- Troubleshooting minor technical issues

- Performing routine maintenance on equipment

- Checking finished products for quality and consistency

We do not provide accommodations. You need to live in the surroundings of Raamsdonkveer.

You will work in 2 shifts from 6:00 to 14:15 and from 14:00 to 22:15.

Requirements for working as a production worker:

- You’ve already worked in a production environment

- You know how to solve little technical issues on the production line

- Willingness to work in a production environment (including exposure to food products)

- Basic understanding of English or Dutch

- Willingness to help your co-workers on the production line

You work in a cleanroom and/or warehouse and ensure products are processed correctly and safely.

- Work according to strict cleanroom procedures and hygiene rules
- Clean and assemble high-tech components
- Perform quality checks on products
- Register materials in the system (WMS)
- Pack and prepare products for shipment
- Load and unload incoming and outgoing goods
- Work together with colleagues from logistics and production

Working hours (2-shifts):

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 15:00 – 24:00
You receive a 18% shift allowance on all hours worked.

- Minimum 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or logistics
- Good command of the English language (reading and speaking)
- Willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Able to work accurately following clear instructions
- Forklift certificate is a plus (or willing to obtain one)

Do you have a strong eye for detail and a passion for data within the fast-paced fashion industry? Please note this is not an active vacancy; we are building a talent pool of skilled Fashion Product Data Coordinators/Specialists for future opportunities.
 
If you excel at managing and analyzing data, maintaining accuracy, and collaborating with cross-functional teams, this is your opportunity to stay ahead and be among the first considered for exciting new roles.
 
What You’ll Do
As a Fashion Product Data Coordinator/Specialist, you will:

- Ensure the quality, accuracy, and completeness of product-related data in systems like PLM and PIM.

- Create and deliver KPI reports on data integrity, sustainability metrics, sample deliveries, and product development progress.

- Collaborate with product development, merchandising, and design teams to maintain seamless data management throughout the product life cycle.

- Perform data cleansing and quality assessments, identifying opportunities for improvement.

- Generate actionable insights to enhance decision-making and visibility into performance areas.

- Work on ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests for divisional teams and leadership.

- Partner with global teams to streamline workflows and ensure consistency across regions.

Who You Are

- You have 2-3 years of experience in data coordination, analytics, or reporting—ideally within fashion, retail, or product development.

- You have excellent communication skills in English (written en verbal).

- You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.

- You are highly proficient in Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP) and PowerPoint.

- Experience with PLM systems and PIM (e.g., Centric PLM) is a strong advantage.

- You have strong organizational and analytical skills with an eye for detail.

- You communicate fluently in English (both written and verbal).

- You thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

- 4 August 2025 - Dienstverband: Permanent - Salaris: € 70.000 - € 80.000 - Locatie: Haarlem 
Location 
Haarlem (NL), with frequent contact and cooperation with our country managers throughout Europe. 
Your Role 
As Product Owner, you will be the lynchpin between Development, Customer Success, our Compliance-as-a-Service team, the founders and our customers. Thanks to your proactive and strategic approach, you ensure product quality and drive continuous improvement while keeping the product vision clear for everyone. 
What will you do? - Roadmap & strategy: You develop and maintain the product roadmap, aligned with business objectives and market demand. - Prioritization & backlog management: You determine which features to prioritize and manage the backlog so we can deliver value quickly. - Stakeholder Communications: You will ensure smooth, timely coordination between Development, Customer Success, Compliance, founders, country managers and customers. - Translate feedback: You turn customer insights into user stories and improvements. - Customer focus: You promote optimal user experience, monitor quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle. 
Who are you? - Experienced Product Owner, preferably in a start-up or scale-up. - Strong in roadmap management, prioritization and stakeholder management. - Excellent organizational, communication and negotiation skills. - Independent, proactive and passionate about impactful products. - Fluent in English, both oral and written. 
Bonus points - Knowledge of AML or broader regulatory compliance. - Command of Dutch or another European language. 
What do we offer? - An energetic, international work environment with short lines of communication. - Daily collaboration with country managers in Europe and direct influence on our expansion. - Room for own initiative and flexibility to shape product strategy. - Competitive salary and benefits, tailored to your experience and ambitions.

jobs.occupation: Machine Operator - Day Shift - Fruit & Vegetables (publications-200739-B)
jobs.description:
As a machine operator at our client in Poeldijk, you are responsible for ensuring our machines run optimally. You ensure that production runs smoothly, in accordance with set specifications and quality requirements.

Your tasks include, among others: 

- Efficiently operating the machines and monitoring the production process.
- Checking and guaranteeing the quality of the products.
- Preventing and resolving minor malfunctions and technical problems.
- Identifying areas for improvement in the production process and communicating these to colleagues and supervisors. 
- Work is carried out using flowpack machines, Aweta and MAF Roda machines for, for example, net clippers/netlon/clippers.

We are looking for an operator who works accurately, is solution-oriented, and responsible, with an eye for both quality and efficiency.

- You speak good English or Dutch.
- You have work experience as an operator.
- You enjoy working with your colleagues to achieve daily goals.
- You are eager to further develop within the profession and are willing to take training courses to do so.
- You can work on Saturdays occasionally (any Saturday shifts are rotated among colleagues).

You will work for a growing food production company specializing in preserved food products packaged in stand-up pouches and jars. Quality, safety, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.
As a Production Worker, you will be part of a dynamic team operating in a 3-shift system. You will support the production process and ensure that all operations run smoothly and efficiently.

- Assist the machine operator during production processes
- Perform physical tasks, including frequent lifting
- Support colleagues where needed to maintain workflow
- Ensure a clean and safe working environment
- Follow hygiene and safety regulations at all times

Requirements

- You speak and understand English or Dutch
- You have your own transportation
- You live within a 20 km radius of Nieuwkuijk
- You are able to perform manual work
- You are flexible and willing to work in a 3-shift system

As a Cleanroom Foil Employee, you will work in a clean production environment where high-tech components are packaged and protected for international transport. You will work accurately based on technical drawings and work instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Cutting foil using production machines for high-tech packaging
- Packaging fragile components for air transport
- Cleaning and packing products and components
- Assembling packaging materials according to instructions
- Working according to cleanroom rules and safety procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the workplace and cleanroom environment clean and organized

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday from 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday from 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience as an assembly or production employee is a plus
- Technical insight and interest in production processes
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard region is a plus

Do you want to keep your cool while staying warm? ❄️ Join the Forklift Driver team in Oss! You will be working in a frozen warehouse of +2 / -18 degrees, but don't worry, you’ll be sitting comfortably in a state-of-the-art heated cabin. Ready to lift your career to new heights? Apply nowww! 💸

What we offer
- A great hourly wage of € 15.63!
- Shift allowance of 8.75% and € 0.25 per hour extra
- Weekly payment of your salary!
- 2 shifts!
6:00-15:00
15:00-00:00
- You can work overtime and weekends for extra cash!
- Location Oss at a Family Company!

Who you are
To be the best fit for our team in Oss, it is important that you meet these requirements, you speak English or Dutch and you have a valid forklift certificate and experience.

- You can work in Oss.

What will you do
As a Forklift Driver Heated Cabin, you are the master of the aisles. Together with your team, you ensure all frozen products are stored perfectly. Ensure trucks are loaded and unloaded with high precision!

Where will you work
As a Forklift Driver Heated Cabin you will be working for a successful family company in the Netherlands. We pride ourselves on having a strong, professional team where everyone knows each other. Even though we work in the cold, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. We offer a stable workplace where you can really build your future!

Job application
Ready to score this job as Forklift Driver? I thought so! Apply now for this Forklift Driver position using the application button. If you have any questions, please call 0412 - 642555.  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

You’ll soon be working for a company that specializes in producing all kinds of stone worktops. These worktops are sold throughout the Netherlands and Germany and eventually end up in people’s homes, so there’s a good chance that you already have one of their worktops in your own kitchen!

As an Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the finishing tasks that cannot be completed by machines. You’ll be working on detailed operations using hand tools and small machinery. Once you’ve mastered your own process, you’ll have the opportunity to move on to the next department within production!

Your main tasks will include:

- Assembling materials using hand tools
- Reading technical drawings
- Performing quality checks
- Communicating with the machining department
- Keeping your workspace clean and organized

Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!

- Living in Zevenhuizen, Rotterdam, The Hague, Leiden, Alphen aan den Rijn, Gouda, Zoetermeer, or surrounding areas
- Please keep in mind that it is not possible to travel to work by public transport.
- Available to work a day shift from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm
- Experience using hand tools or hobby experience in making furniture
- Good command of Dutch or English

Are you technically inclined and enjoy working independently? As a digital print operator, you will be the driving force behind an advanced printing machine. You will ensure the printing process runs smoothly, from loading paper rolls to performing maintenance. You will oversee the entire process from start to finish, making you responsible for the final product!

What will you do?

- Prepare and manage paper supply
- Manage paper and ink inventory
- Set up and operate the printing machine
- Oversee the printing process, including post-production
- Perform general maintenance
- Develop and maintain the production schedule

- You speak either Dutch or English fluently
- You live near Etten-Leur (within a 30 km radius)
- You are eager to learn and have a proactive attitude
- You have your own transportation

Do you have experience as a supervisor? Are you looking for a responsible job? Are you able to optimize day-to-day activities while minimizing costs? Then we are looking for you!

What are you going to do?
- Organize workflow by assigning responsibilities and preparing schedules
- Responsible for scheduling control
- Maintain material control and quality control
- Responsible for other duties on assembly line
- Oversee and coach employees
- Identify issues in efficiency and suggest improvements
- Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.

What do we offer?
In addition to a competitive and negotiable salary, we offer:

- weekly payment of this salary,
- 8% holiday allowance and 25 days of leave (on a full-time basis),
- participation in the pension scheme from day 1, and
- personal development. During your contract you have access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Our client is an employer that offers equal opportunities for everyone and embraces diversity in the employee population. Our client is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department.

You often work together with (international) colleagues. They communicate with each other in English or Dutch.

What do we ask?
- High School degree, college degree preferred
- Minimum 5+ years of relative working experience in electronic or computer industry preferred
- Solid understanding of computer system assembly
- Possess basic mechanical knowledge
- Familiarity with computer or electronic components testing and inspection
- Experience with mechanical assembly, cable routing, and quality standards
- Strong attention to detail, including accuracy and thoroughness
- Ability to comprehend spoken and written English
- Ability to work overtime and weekends depending on business demands.

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

Are you a cheerful multitasker with a driver's license? 🚗💨 Then we are looking for you as a delivery driver for AH Online! Get started at Albert Heijn in Dordrecht, and discover the flexible working hours. 📅

After 13 weeks you also earn €18,83 per hour! NICE! 💰 This great job is a real #baanrader! 🤩

Would you like to know more about this position? Then read on! 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 150 when you bring a friend!
- Earn € 18,83 per hour after thirteen weeks!
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Flexible working hours
- Travel allowance
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you are physically able to lift heavy crates. You can also work independently to deliver groceries on time. What else you need to know:

- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are in possession of a driving license B for at least six months;
- You have private transport to get to the location.

What will you do
No day is the same as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. But that's also what makes the work so much fun! You start each shift by collecting the key and the route lists. You can also take something tasty from the refrigerator with you for the road. Time to deliver! You drive to the right locations via your navigation. Here, you can deliver your groceries to your door. You also check the payment like a real professional. Everything arranged? Time to leave again! You get into the van and return to the depot. Here, you clean the car for the next working day. Ready to hit the road again! Do you enjoy it so much that you want to continue growing after a while? Then you can always become a buddy, for example!

Where will you work
Working as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online means a lot of contact with different people. In other words: a nice and fun team! You will meet each other in the waiting area during each service. A great opportunity to get to know each other even better! Drink a cup of coffee together! Or get so

As an Assembly & Repair Technician, you work in a modern production environment. Together with 6 to 8 colleagues per shift, you make sure technical parts are assembled, checked and prepared for shipment.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling technical parts according to drawings and work instructions
- Repairing and checking plastic, metal and wooden parts
- Packing fragile parts in large crates for international transport
- Carrying out quality checks during and after the work
- Working with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- Reporting defects or deviations to your supervisor
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe

You work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 to 15:00
- Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- For this role, we ask:- You are available full-time for a 2-shift schedule
- You live in the Eindhoven, Veldhoven, Best or Helmond region
- You have experience in technical work, assembly or repair
- You can work with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- You can read technical drawings and follow work instructions
- You have a good command of English, both spoken and written
- Experience with accurate and independent working is a plus

As a demolition worker, you are responsible for carrying out demolition and clean-up activities safely and efficiently. Experience is not required; motivation and a practical attitude are most important.

Your tasks include:

- Demolishing walls, floors and other constructions using hand tools and small machinery
- Cleaning and removing debris from demolition sites
- Separating construction waste and materials according to safety regulations
- Assisting colleagues during renovation and demolition projects
- Loading and unloading materials and tools
- Following VGM and safety instructions on-site
- Keeping the workplace clean and organised

You work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Early shift: Monday to Friday from 06:00 to 15:00
- Late shift: Monday to Friday from 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance on top of your salary.

For this position, it is important that you enjoy physical work and can work safely on construction and demolition sites.

We ask the following:

- You have an active and practical working attitude
- You are physically fit and able to perform heavy work
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- You understand basic safety and VGM instructions
- You can work both independently and in a team
- A driver's license B is an advantage
- You have a good command of the English language

Would you like to work in a flower paradise? 💐 Join us as a warehouse worker in the flower department at Royal FloraHolland! In this role, you will sort flowers and place them on carts. You will start earning € 17.98 per hour straight away (including holiday pay)! You also have a chance to get a permanent contract. And... you get to take a bunch of flowers home every month. YES! 🌻 Read on quickly. 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 17.98 per hour right from the start!
- Morning shifts – free afternoons/evenings!
- A chance to get a contract with Royal Flora!
- Pick-up service provided by Flora in the morning!
- Public transport costs are fully reimbursed!
- A free bunch of flowers to take home every month!

Who you are
As a warehouse worker at Royal Flora Holland, you meet the following requirements:

- You are 18 years or older (due to working hours);
- You are available on weekdays from 06:00 AM - 02.00 PM;
- You are available from Monday to Friday;
- You are able to work in Aalsmeer;
- You speak Dutch or English;
- Your height is at least 165 cm;
- You are available for at least 4 months.

What will you do
As a warehouse worker at Royal FloraHolland, you make sure the right flowers reach the right customer! You will organize the racks according to the customer's orders. Using your cart, you will collect the correct flowers from the warehouse. 💪 During your training period, you will get plenty of time to master this process. On top of that, a dedicated training team will be there to guide you! 🎉

Where will you work
Royal FloraHolland has been bringing growers and buyers together for over 100 years. But they cannot do this without you as a warehouse worker! ✨ You will join a great team with nice colleagues. But that's not all! You can regularly enjoy a beautiful bouquet of flowers for your home. 💐

Do you enjoy taking control and ensuring everything runs smoothly? As a Print Production Worker, you'll be responsible for delivering print materials in perfect condition to our clients. From bundling and packing to cutting and folding, you'll tackle the work with enthusiasm.

Responsibilities:

- Bundling and packing print materials
- Cutting flyers, brochures, and folders
- Creating stapled brochures
- Folding various types of folders

- Good command of the English language
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team
